#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const long long mod = 1000000007;
long long p, k;

long long power(long long base, long long exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    if (exp == 1) return base % mod;
    long long half = power(base, exp / 2);
    half = (half * half) % mod;
    if (exp % 2 == 0) return half;
    return (half * (base % mod)) % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << power(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << power(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long m = 1;
    long long t = k % p;
    while (true) {
        m++;
        t = (t * (k % p)) % p;
        if (t == 1) {
            cout << power(p, (p - 1) / m);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
